guidanceReview.rationale: Resumes Hub recovery after control loss during a runtime update, cancels background recovery when its last client exits, and publishes supervisor status atomically. Interrupted switches are not replayed. The SDK patch initializes declared capability handlers earlier; ws preserves its wire format while fixing buffering and using native masking where available. Tooling updates leave source contracts unchanged. Tool guidance, control and extension protocols, and durable state remain compatible with 1.0.2 and earlier epoch-1 releases. The p-wait-for update affects extension polling only.
